_comment: Raptor's egg library (library/README.md). Based on the CanvasMC egg in pterodactyl/game-eggs (MIT).
name: Minecraft: CanvasMC
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: CanvasMC, a Folia fork with fixes to region threading and extra performance work. Runs plugins made for Folia. Any Minecraft version CanvasMC builds, with tuned Java settings.
startup: mkdir -p plugins/bStats; b=plugins/bStats/config.yml; touch $b; if ! grep -q "^serverUuid:" $b; then read -r u < /proc/sys/kernel/random/uuid; echo "serverUuid: \"$u\"" >> $b; fi; grep -q "^logFailedRequests:" $b || echo "logFailedRequests: false" >> $b; if grep -q "^enabled:" $b; then sed -i "s/^enabled:.*/enabled: {{BSTATS}}/" $b; else echo "enabled: {{BSTATS}}" >> $b; fi; read -r need 2>/dev/null < .raptor-java || need=8; java -version 2>&1 | awk -F'"' -v need="$need" '/version/ { split($2, v, "."); have = (v[1] == "1") ? v[2] : v[1]; if (have + 0 < need + 0) { printf "This Minecraft version needs Java %s or newer, and the server runs Java %s. Choose Java %s in Startup, then start the server again.\n", need, have, need; exit 1 } exit }' && exec java -Xms128M -XX:MaxRAMPercentage=85.0 -XX:+IgnoreUnrecognizedVMOptions -XX:+UseCompactObjectHeaders -XX:+UnlockExperimentalVMOptions -XX:+UseG1GC -XX:+ParallelRefProcEnabled -XX:MaxGCPauseMillis=200 -XX:+DisableExplicitGC -XX:+PerfDisableSharedMem -XX:G1NewSizePercent=30 -XX:G1MaxNewSizePercent=40 -XX:G1HeapRegionSize=8M -XX:G1ReservePercent=20 -XX:G1MixedGCCountTarget=4 -XX:InitiatingHeapOccupancyPercent=15 -XX:G1MixedGCLiveThresholdPercent=90 -XX:G1RSetUpdatingPauseTimePercent=5 -XX:SurvivorRatio=32 -XX:MaxTenuringThreshold=1 -Dterminal.jline=false -Dterminal.ansi=true --add-modules=jdk.incubator.vector -jar {{SERVER_JARFILE}} nogui

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Minecraft: CanvasMC. Downloads the CanvasMC build for the chosen Minecraft
# version from CanvasMC. CanvasMC publishes no checksums, so the jar is
# checked to be a whole, readable archive before it's used. Worlds, plugins
# and settings are never touched, and the jar is only replaced once the new
# one checks out.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server

ua="raptor-egg-library/1.0 (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
jar="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
get() { curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -H "Accept: application/json" "$1"; }
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }

all=$(get "https://canvasmc.io/api/v2/builds?project=canvas") || fail "CanvasMC can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
# Successful builds of known Minecraft versions, newest first.
builds=$(jq -c '[.builds[] | select(.result == "SUCCESS" and .channelVersion != "unknown")] | sort_by(-.buildNumber)' <<<"$all")
version="${MC_VERSION:-latest}"
build="${CANVAS_BUILD:-latest}"
[ -n "$version" ] || version=latest
[ -n "$build" ] || build=latest

if [ "$build" != latest ]; then
    info=$(jq -c --argjson b "$build" 'first(.[] | select(.buildNumber == $b)) // empty' <<<"$builds")
    [ -n "$info" ] || fail "CanvasMC has no successful build $build. Set Build to latest, or to one of its builds."
    if [ "$version" != latest ] && [ "$(jq -r '.channelVersion' <<<"$info")" != "$version" ]; then
        fail "CanvasMC build $build is for Minecraft $(jq -r '.channelVersion' <<<"$info"), not $version. Set Build to latest, or to a build for $version."
    fi
elif [ "$version" = latest ]; then
    info=$(jq -c '.[0] // empty' <<<"$builds")
    [ -n "$info" ] || fail "CanvasMC has no build to install right now. Reinstall to try again later."
else
    info=$(jq -c --arg v "$version" 'first(.[] | select(.channelVersion == $v)) // empty' <<<"$builds")
    [ -n "$info" ] || fail "CanvasMC has no Minecraft $version. Set Version to latest, or to a version CanvasMC has, such as $(jq -r '.[0].channelVersion' <<<"$builds")."
fi
version=$(jq -r '.channelVersion' <<<"$info")
id=$(jq -r '.buildNumber' <<<"$info")
url=$(jq -r '.downloadUrl' <<<"$info")

# The Java version that Minecraft version needs, from Mojang (CanvasMC
# itself needs 21 or newer).
java=21
if manifest=$(get https://piston-meta.mojang.com/mc/game/version_manifest_v2.json); then
    meta_url=$(jq -r --arg v "$version" '.versions[] | select(.id == $v) | .url' <<<"$manifest")
    if [ -n "$meta_url" ] && meta=$(get "$meta_url"); then
        java=$(jq -r '.javaVersion.majorVersion // 21' <<<"$meta")
        [ "$java" -ge 21 ] || java=21
    fi
fi

if [ -f "$jar" ] && [ "$(cat .raptor-canvasmc 2>/dev/null)" = "$version $id" ]; then
    echo "CanvasMC $version build $id is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading CanvasMC $version build $id"
    curl -fsSL --retry 3 -A "$ua" -o "$jar.new" "$url"
    unzip -tqq "$jar.new" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { rm -f "$jar.new"; fail "The download is incomplete or damaged. Reinstall to try again."; }
    mv -f "$jar.new" "$jar"
    echo "$version $id" > .raptor-canvasmc
fi
# The Java version it needs, which the startup command checks.
echo "$java" > .raptor-java
echo "Installed CanvasMC $version build $id. It needs Java $java or newer."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Minecraft version, such as 1.21.8, or latest for the newest one CanvasMC builds. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Build
variables.description: The CanvasMC build, or latest for the newest build of that version.

variables.name: Jar file
variables.description: The name of the server's jar file.

variables.name: Usage statistics
variables.description: Send anonymous statistics about the server and its plugins to bStats.org, where plugin authors see them (true or false).
